class.name: ReflectionProbePool
class.brief_description: Reflection probes at the nearest of many sites round the player.
class.description: Wet streets, glass and car paint should reflect the place round them, but a large world can't have probes everywhere, and screen-space reflections only show what's on screen. ReflectionProbePool places [member count] probes at the sites nearest the [member observer], and moves them as the player goes. Add a [ReflectionProbe] as its child, set up as every probe should be (box projection, blend distance, which layers it captures): the pool's probes are copies of it, and it stays hidden. Then add the sites, in the pool's own frame (map coordinates when the pool sits at the world's origin): [codeblock] for junction in junctions: $Reflections.add_site(Transform3D(junction.basis, junction.position + Vector3.UP * 9.0), Vector3(junction.width, 18.0, junction.width), Vector3(0, -7.5, 0)) [/codeblock] Capturing a probe draws the scene round it, so new probes are placed one a frame. Leave what moves (traffic, people) out of the template's [member ReflectionProbe.cull_mask]: captured once, a car would stay in every puddle. Call [method recapture] when the light changes enough to show (the time of day, the weather).

method.name: add_site
method.description: Adds a place a probe can go, and returns its ID: the probe's [param transform] (the middle of its box) in the pool's frame, its box's [param size], and where it captures from, as [member ReflectionProbe.origin_offset] (a driver's eye over a road, say).

method.name: clear_sites
method.description: Removes every site and its probe.

method.name: get_placed_sites
method.description: The sites that have a probe now, in order.

method.name: recapture
method.description: Captures every probe again, one a frame: after a change of light that their reflections should show.

method.name: remove_site
method.description: Removes a site, and its probe if it has one.

members.member: How many probes the pool places at once.
Metres above or below the observer past which sites are left out, or 0 for no limit: on an expressway, the junctions of the street beneath aren't its own.
What the sites are chosen round: the player, or what the camera follows. Unless set, the viewport's camera.
Metres within which sites can get a probe.
